component.name: Java Installer
component.summary: Install and manage OpenJDK and Oracle JDK versions

description.p: A distribution independent GTK4 application to install, remove and switch between Java runtimes. OpenJDK builds come from your distribution (apt, dnf or pacman); Oracle JDK archives are downloaded directly from Oracle after you accept Oracle's licence — nothing from Oracle is redistributed by this project.
Fork of pardus-java-installer, extended to Debian/Ubuntu, Fedora and Arch families.
First release of the fork: GTK4/libadwaita UI, apt/dnf/pacman backends, Oracle downloads with licence acceptance and checksum verification.
